doc: A pipeline added to a bundle file that has no resources (databricks.fbl#configuration; FBL 0.14, section 6.2; spec 066, FR-039). Its body is the document of etalii.adp.ide.standalone's BundleWriter test AddResourceSkeleton_OnAFileWithoutResources_CreatesTheSection at edbddc92e (src/diagrams/databricks/backend/EtAlii.Adp.Diagram.Databricks.Tests/BundleWriter.Tests.cs), its text byte for byte.

steps.doc: In a bundle without resources, the add creates resources: at the end of the body and pipelines: below it, as create's end and the missing levels write them, then the member, all at one offset (FBL 0.4 and 0.14, section 6.2).

splices.text:
first:
      name: first
      libraries:
        - notebook:
            path: transformations/first

expectFiles.../fresh.yml:
bundle:
  name: fresh
resources:
  pipelines:
    first:
      name: first
      libraries:
        - notebook:
            path: transformations/first
